note: Every palette this app can wear, described in ROLES. Palette and mode are independent axes (hub PALETTES.md §6): a family carries a light and a dark, and the reader chooses each separately. `npm run palette:check` holds every family in both modes against docs/colour-inventory.json — the pairs the UI actually renders — by arithmetic, with no browser. `npm run palettes` generates public/palettes.css from this file, which is the ONE source for the values: PALETTES.md warns that N declarations times F families is a drift factory, and says to consolidate before adding families. See ADR-0110.

quietkeep.name: Quietkeep
quietkeep.why: the original — warm paper by day, deep blue-grey by night

instrument.name: Instrument
instrument.why: cool and crisp — a steel-blue day, a near-black night

paper.name: Paper
paper.why: a warm kraft page with white cards, and a deep teal for anything you can press

mono.name: Mono
mono.why: no hue at all — neutral grey by day, neutral charcoal by night

soft.name: Soft
soft.why: the lowest glare — a dimmed page and a night that is grey rather than black
